capabilities: Transcribe m4a and mp3 files locally with Whisper.cpp or via OpenAI and Groq cloud APIs
Detect spoken language and transcribe in any Whisper-supported language
Extract summaries, key points, action items, and follow-up questions from transcripts
Run AI analysis locally with Ollama or in the cloud with OpenRouter
Label distinct speakers in multi-person recordings
extras: Desktop-only and Windows-only (Windows 10/11 64-bit); no mobile support yet. OpenRouter appears in the transcription-mode dropdown but cannot transcribe audio — it powers only the analysis step. Speaker diarization is currently limited, with full support planned via Assembly AI or local pyannote. Local transcription requires 4GB+ RAM and 2-3GB of disk space for models. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian stores audio recordings but has no built-in way to transcribe them or turn them into structured notes.

requires.name: OpenRouter API key (required for analysis in all modes); OpenAI or Groq keys for cloud transcription

summary: Audio transcription plugin that converts m4a/mp3 recordings into markdown transcripts and extracts summaries, key points, and action items using AI.
